entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: The Miracle X salesman issued an[n]apology. He's admitted the drink[n]has no medicinal properties.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: He's refunding anyone who asks,[n]and it sounds like he plans to make[n]truly healthy products now.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Miracle X itself tastes fine, so he[n]plans to sell it as an ordinary[n]refreshment. 1,000 yen a bottle.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: You know... Many of the ones[n]buying his stock now are the same[n]ones who claimed to be cured.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I suppose once you experience a[n]"miracle," it's hard to let go. Even[n]if there's no scientific evidence.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Ah, but in any case, the situation[n]is now resolved. Thank you, Joker!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I guess sometimes your mind can be[n]tricked into healing your body, huh?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Not like that's reliable, though, so[n]it's best to go to a doctor whenever[n]you need it.
